content.text: Backyard Music Co. – Festival Refund Policy
At Backyard Music Co., every Nashville Takeover is a multi-day, multi-venue experience that requires extensive planning, artist coordination, and advance production costs. Because of this,
all ticket sales are final
Refunds Are Only Issued In the Following Cases:
Backyard Music Co. system error
If a ticketing or payment error occurs on our end, we will issue a full refund.
Event cancellation by Backyard Music Co.
In the rare case that we must cancel an event entirely, all affected ticket holders will receive a full refund.
No Refunds For:
Schedule changes
Artist changes or substitutions
Weather conditions
Personal schedule conflicts
Travel issues
Venue changes
Dissatisfaction with the surprise lineup
Choosing not to attend
Any circumstance outside of the two cases listed above
Because our events are intimate and capacity-limited, every ticket directly impacts our ability to run these festivals in each community, which is why we maintain a strict no-refund policy.
Special Exceptions
